sources.entry: YPlayer - A multifunctional app for live captions, audio/video transcription, and subtitle translation.

summary.name: YPlayer
summary.one_liner: A video and audio player for macOS and iOS that generates live captions, offline subtitles, and translations on-device.
use_cases: Watching foreign language videos with translated subtitles
Transcribing audio or video into SRT or TXT files
Taking notes from interviews with live transcription
Studying English listening with repeated subtitle lines
Watching video offline in places with poor network
summary.what_it_does: YPlayer plays video and audio and generates real-time captions using speech recognition. It can transcribe recorded or live audio, produce offline subtitles, and translate transcripts into several languages, with real-time translation on macOS 15.0 and iOS 18.0. Subtitles can be exported as TXT, SRT, PDF, or LRC, and batch transcription and batch SRT translation are supported for files in a folder. The page says speech recognition runs on-device using Apple's CoreML and Speech frameworks and that the app does not actively upload voice or video data.
notable: On-device speech recognition via Apple CoreML and Speech frameworks, with no voice or video upload
Subtitle repetition and search aimed at English listening practice
Blurs hardcoded subtitles and generates captions even when the player is muted
One purchase unlocks Premium on both macOS and iOS
caveats: Premium features require purchase; the page mentions a fee policy and a special offer that is temporarily suspended
Recording live caption currently supports only Chinese and English
The first use downloads a language model, which needs a network connection
